{{Top|leg}}
The '''Galactic Science Foundation''' was a scientific foundation active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the members of the foundation awarded the Herpetology Award to [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Relan Smiff]] for his discovery of giant [[fanned rawl]]s on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="Sony">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Star%20Wars%20Galaxies:%20Bestiary%20-%20Naboo|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Bestiary &ndash; Naboo}}</ref>
